Irish Visa Decision Tracker

Live • Personal Project

What has each Irish visa office decided — and how do decisions trend over time? A live public tracker of visa decisions from six Irish visa offices (New Delhi, Beijing, Abu Dhabi, Abuja, Ankara and Dublin), plus Stamp 1G and employment-permit processing dates. A scheduled Python scraper on GitHub Actions turns flat official reports into 61,154 searchable decision rows, with daily summaries, trends and a public correction ledger.
